# IAMS Campus

IAMS Campus is a premium educational institute located in Malappuram, Kerala, India. We specialize in providing industry-relevant certification and degree programs designed to bridge the gap between traditional education and modern career demands.

## Contact Information
- **Phone:** +91 96331 30516
- **Email:** info@iamscampus.in
- **Address:** NP Center, Kakkad, Malappuram, Kerala, India
- **Website:** https://iamscampus.in

## Programs Offered
We offer comprehensive 6-month certification programs and 1-year degrees with dedicated placement support. Over 1,000+ students have successfully placed in corporate roles.

- Digital Marketing
- Graphic Designing
- Business Management
- Corporate Accounts with GST
- Spoken English
- AI Integrated Digital Tools
- +1 & +2 Commerce Tuition

## Mission
Evolving as a globally eminent institute for career solutions. We achieve our objective in an environment swarmed with fairness, honesty, and courtesy towards students, faculties, parents, and society. Paving the perfect path to help students achieve their intimate dreams.
